audit.input_preprocessing: Upstream PIL square resize 256, DINOv2 processor (224 crop/257 tokens), SigLIP text, FP32 eval
audit.compatibility: Unused DeepSpeed import omitted; activation checkpointing remains disabled as in official inference. No model layers changed.

audit.checkpoint_selection: Official synthetic+ChangeSim checkpoint selected before inference because target imagery is indoors.
audit.input_preprocessing: RGB float/255, ImageNet z-score, full branch 520x520 and low branch 256x256; no test augmentation
audit.compatibility: Native PyTorch equivalent of upstream zero-padded 9x9 channel-mean correlation. Original train.py architecture, use_pac=False; no head replaced.

pairing: Exact upstream SceneDiff view-overlap weights from mesh-input branch; all nonzero counterparts used. No change scores used to choose frame pairs.
scenediff_baseline: Existing original and mesh SceneDiff outputs on the same 30 perspective views are fixed in both input-mode comparisons. SceneDiff was not rerun directly on full ERP.
conditions: 30 common views from 20 full ERP frames, two different floors, no temporal change ground truth. All new-model probability thresholds fixed at 0.5 before inference.
comparison: Candidate pixel agreement, not precision/recall or object detection accuracy. SceneDiff merged IDs differ from per-image connected components.
